note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it (via Exophase and PSNProfiles). Every guide is written in our own words for this entry: where a method comes from the official description alone, the guide says so and does not claim it was checked in the game.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then side strands, then activities and collectibles, and save the 100% completion trophy for last, since it sweeps up most of the long grinds on the way. If anything is still locked, the checklist's Remaining filter shows exactly what is left.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Method: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete Gone Fishing, the opening mission. This is the first mission of the game: follow the on-screen objectives through it and the trophy unlocks when the mission ends. It cannot be missed — it is the story's opening beat.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Play through the story until the chapter closes; the trophy unlocks at the chapter-complete screen. Unmissable — you must finish Chapter 1 to reach the rest of the game.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Same as the other chapter trophies: play the story to the end of Chapter 2 and the trophy unlocks at the chapter-complete screen. Unmissable story progress.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. This is a named story mission, so take it when the story offers it and play it through to its end screen — the trophy pops when the mission ends. It is flagged missable as a warning built from the official description: if the mission cannot be replayed, there is no second chance.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. This is the long one: 100% means finishing the story, the side strands, the activities and the collectibles the game counts. Do it last — the roadmap's earlier stages cover most of what counts, and the checklist's Remaining filter shows what is still open. The exact 100% checklist is not published in the official trophy description, so treat the game's own 100% screen as the authority.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. A stunt is any jump, near-miss, wheelie, stoppie, drift or mid-air trick the game flashes as a stunt — the counter builds up across the whole playthrough, so drive fast, jump ramps and chain tricks whenever you travel. You do not need all 250 in one session; the total is cumulative. The exact list of moves that count is not in the official description, so if the counter stalls, vary the trick: ramps, airtime and near misses are the usual triggers.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Count: PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 250). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The game counts 9 activity types (PSN tracks 9). Try one of each: the types include the shooting range, drone races, fishing, arcade games, bowling and meditation spots, plus the other open-world activities the game lists. Open an activity's menu or play one round of it and the type counts as tried. Use this guide's activity trophies as a checklist of the types; if a type is unclear, the in-game activity menu is the authority.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Count: PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 9 types). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. PSN tracks 42 challenges. Visit the shooting range and work through all 42, scoring gold in each — gold usually means beating a score or time bar, so replay a challenge until the gold medal shows. The range's own scoring screen shows which challenges are still below gold; clear them one at a time and use this guide to track what is left.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Count: PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 42). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. PSN tracks 14 locations. Find each of the 14 Top Fun drone race spots around Leonida, enter the race and finish first. Losing a race locks nothing — just retry that location. The race spots are the Top Fun-branded ones, and the in-game map marks activity locations once you have found them.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Count: PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 14). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The trophy counts 20 distinct race events won — not the same race 20 times. Races include street races, drone races and any other race events the game lists. Work through the race locations on the map and tick each new win; the count climbs with every first-time victory.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Count: PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 20). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him — the challenge is a head-to-head fishing contest, so land the better catch or the higher score. If you lose, the challenge can be retried. Where Cal's challenge sits on the map is not in the official description; look for the fishing activity marker.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade machine, start a game and play it through to its end — finishing one full arcade game unlocks the trophy. Any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest one you can find.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is one of the side characters with a mission strand: take his missions when they appear and play through to his final one. Side strands stay open alongside the story, so this is not a race — but finish Andy's strand before the final mission if you want it done before the endgame, since whether strands stay open after the story is not yet confirmed.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. PSN tracks 18 spots. Find the 18 meditation spots scattered across the state, sit and meditate at each one. Spots are usually scenic viewpoints; the game marks meditation locations once found, and the count is cumulative.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Count: PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 18). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand asks you to hunt one specific unique animal — follow his missions until he names the animal, then track and hunt that one animal. It is the unique animal that counts, not just any animal, so wait for Bret to name the target before you hunt.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Collectible cards are hidden around Leonida in sets: gather every card of a set to complete it, and complete 3 full sets. Cards are a collectible hunt — check the usual hiding places (shops, interiors, landmarks) and use the in-game collection screen to see which sets are still missing cards.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Count: PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 3 sets). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the game's photo-tagging activity: do it at 100 different locations across Leonida. Each location counts once, so keep moving to new spots rather than repeating one. The count is cumulative across the whole map — fold it into your exploration and the number climbs on its own.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Count: PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 100). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives — the challenge list in the game's challenges screen shows them; complete any 50. They range from driving and combat feats to exploration, and they stack up naturally across a full playthrough; check the list for the ones you are close to and finish those first.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Count: PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 50). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape while your partner is still with you. Break line of sight, hide or outrun the search until the wanted level clears — the trophy pops when the heat is off and your partner is still in the escape with you. How the game counts 'with your partner' is not in the official description; keep your partner in the vehicle or beside you through the whole escape.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner, rob a shop, then rob a second and a third without ever losing the wanted level between them — keep the wanted level alive from the first robbery to the third. Plan a route past three shops close together, keep moving, and do not let the heat drop to zero until the third robbery is done. Losing the wanted level resets the chain, so retry the run.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Count: PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 3). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Discover 100 different vehicles — driving, entering or finding a new vehicle model counts as a discovery. The count is cumulative: the more of Leonida's traffic and parked cars you try, the faster it climbs. 100 distinct vehicles, not 100 cars of the same model, so vary what you get into.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Count: PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 100). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus (the game's slow-down aiming mode) and take down 5 enemies before it ends. Pick a fight with a group — five enemies in one activation is the count. If the focus runs out early, retry; it is a skill moment, not a grind, so find a spot with plenty of enemies and line them up before you trigger it.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Count: PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 5). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave VCIA (the airport) in a way the schedule did not plan — the trophy's joke is an impromptu exit. The most likely trigger is taking an aircraft from the airport and flying out without a scheduled flight. The exact trigger is not spelled out in the official description, so try the obvious one first; this method is our own read, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhino tanks, and the exact trigger is not spelled out: the most likely read is that it involves the Rhino tank — destroying one, or surviving one's attention. Try taking down a Rhino tank when the army rolls one out at high wanted levels. This is the least certain trophy in the list: the guide flags it as not yet confirmed, and the in-game trophy text or PSN's count, if one appears, is the authority.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game. Trigger not yet confirmed.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Pick a jewelry store, get in and out with the loot without any guard, camera or witness spotting you — stealth is the whole trophy. If you are detected, the attempt fails; leave, let the heat die down and try again, quieter. Plan the entry and the exit before you go in.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Vault robberies are the big heist-style robberies — plan each one, get the vault open, grab the take and escape the police response. Five vaults, each with a clean escape, and the count is cumulative.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Count: PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 5). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, crack it open and take the cash, then escape the police response. One truck, one escape — the trophy pops once you are clear.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. PSN tracks 52 areas. Visit all 52 named areas of the state — the map fills in as you go, and the area counter climbs with each new named area you enter. Drive the whole map: cities, towns, swamps and coast, until every area has been visited. The in-game map is the authority on which areas are still unvisited.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Count: PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 52). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. PSN tracks 9 gangs. Each gang runs illegal operations around Leonida: rob one operation of each of the 9 gangs. The operations are the gang-run side activities, and the game shows which gang an operation belongs to — work through the list gang by gang until all nine are done.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Count: PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 9). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view — a quiet moment trophy, and one of the easiest in the list. Any beachfront bar with a view on Ocean Beach should do; sit, order, and let the scene play.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Take a vehicle in a showroom and smash your way out through the glass — the classic GTA showroom exit. Drive through the front of a vehicle showroom and the trophy pops. The exact showroom is not named in the official description; any vehicle showroom should do.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl — 'follow-through' is the bowling motion, so play a game of bowling there and the trophy pops when the game ends. The alley is named in the description, so this one has its location pinned down.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague: it reads as a story moment with your partner that draws a crowd or a big audience — 'mass appeal' suggests something the public notices. The exact trigger is not in the official description, so this one is flagged as not yet confirmed; play the partner story beats and watch for a public moment. When the community pins the trigger down, this guide will name it.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game. Trigger not yet confirmed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count to 500. Across the game you make small choices — dialogue picks, life decisions, how you handle moments — and PSN counts them: make 500 choices in total. It is a cumulative count, not one big decision, so just keep playing and choosing; the trophy pops at 500. Which moments count as choices is not spelled out in the official description; the in-game count is the authority.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Count: PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 500). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: May require failing a specific event once, then passing it — the scenario is not named in the official description.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The trophy's joke is about succeeding on the second try — most likely a specific event you fail once and then pass on the second attempt. If it is tied to one specific scenario, it may only be attempted when that scenario comes around, which is why the guide flags it as possibly missable: pass it first try and you may never get the 'second time' the trophy wants. The honest position is that the exact scenario is not in the official description, so this is the guide's best read, not a confirmed method — if you spot a challenge that lets you retry, fail it once on purpose, then pass it.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game. Scenario not yet confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The description reads as a random strange event — something odd in the world that you witness. Keep your eyes open around Leonida for the weird: strange lights, odd encounters, things that do not belong. The exact event is not named in the official description, so the guide flags it as not yet confirmed — when the community pins the event down, this guide will name it.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game. Event not yet confirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. From a moving vehicle, knock someone down with a melee weapon — a drive-by with a bat or similar melee weapon instead of a gun. Line up a target beside the road, swing the melee weapon from the vehicle as you pass, and the trophy pops when the target goes down.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty money: launder them through your contacts until you have earned $250,000 clean. The total is cumulative — keep laundering as you earn marked bills and the count climbs to $250,000.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Count: PSNProfiles (PSN tracks $250,000). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in total across the game's shops — clothes, food, weapons, anything the shops sell. The total is cumulative across every shop, so normal spending across a playthrough adds up; buy the expensive items if you want it done sooner.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Count: PSNProfiles (PSN tracks $100,000). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. PSN tracks 8 garage properties. Buy all 8 garages around Leonida — each one costs money, so save up or buy them as you can afford them. The property menu lists them; own all 8 and the trophy pops.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (name, description, grade). Count: PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 8). Method: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: On the Spot
